note: Phase B (character fidelity): what the production characters' zone materials add to their glTF (CharacterMaterials.cs). Roughness and metalness per zone are already in each character's ORM atlas (tools/asset_pipeline/charprod/orm_zones.py); these are the effects glTF has no field for.

lods.note: Metres from the camera: LOD0 (the full mesh) to lod0_end - past any dialogue or third-person framing - LOD1 to lod1_end, LOD2 beyond; each switch cross-fades over margin.
